name: Echo CS-303T
blurb: 30.1 cc top-handle. Echo's spec table: 12″ bar, 14″ in the U.S. Chart: 3/8″ low profile, .050″, 45 drive links at 12″ and 52 at 14″.
intro: The CS-303T is a top-handle saw. Echo's specification table gives it 30.1 cc and a 12″ bar, with 14″ in the U.S. only. The Bars and Chains chart heads a block “CS-303T/310” that also includes a 16″ row used on the CS-310. This page lists the two lengths the specification table gives the CS-303T. Both are 91PX chain, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 5/32″ file: 45 drive links on 12″ (bar 12A0CD3745C) and 52 on 14″ (bar 14A0CD3752C). For a 16″ bar, use the CS-310 page or the stamp.

bars.note: Echo bar 12A0CD3745C; chain 91PX45CQ. Non-replaceable-nose bar. Listed on the CS-303T/310 chart block; the specification table gives the CS-303T a 12″ bar.
Echo bar 14A0CD3752C; chain 91PX52CQ. Non-replaceable-nose bar. Echo's specification table says 14″ for the CS-303T in the U.S. only. The chart also sells this loop as 91PX52CQ-3.
